description: Applies changes to a Plot Speaks campaign's saved world: new characters, damage and healing, spells cast, items, gold, rests, location, day, people met (the dead stay dead), quests, fight turn order (initiative) and a one-line story note. Send only what changed; fields left out are untouched. Returns a RECORDED list, a REFUSED list giving the reason for each change the campaign's rules do not allow, and the updated state. Saves to the campaign play (no personal data). An unknown slug, a non-campaign story or an unknown play id returns an error.

day.description: The campaign day number, e.g. 3, if it moved on

initiative.description: The turn order in a fight, first is up, naming only creatures the party can see (the screen shows it), e.g. ["Mira","Goblin","Tobin"]; sending the list again replaces it, and an empty list ends the fight

location.description: Where the party is now, e.g. the Sunken Chapel (kept to 120 characters)

note.description: One line for the story so far (kept to 240 characters)

npcs.description: People met or changed, each {name, status, note}; status e.g. friendly, hostile or dead (the dead stay dead); notes kept to 160 characters. E.g. [{"name":"Old Bram","status":"friendly"}]

party.description: Up to 6 party members to add or change, matched by name (an unknown name adds a character). Each: name, plus any of class, level (1 to 5), hp, max_hp, damage, heal, spend_slot (spell level 1 to 5), max_slots, conditions, add_items, remove_items, gold (change, may be negative), remove. E.g. [{"name":"Mira","damage":4,"spend_slot":"1"}]

play_id.description: The campaign's play id from start_story or world_recall, e.g. 3f2b8c1e-9d4a-4e7b-a1c2-5b6d7e8f9a0b

quests.description: Quests taken or changed, each {name, status, note}; status is open, done or failed; notes kept to 160 characters. E.g. [{"name":"Find the lantern","status":"done"}]

rest.description: "short" or "long": applies that rest's recovery to the party under the campaign's rules

slug.description: The campaign's slug or title, e.g. the campaign named in start_story's script

name: world_update
title: Update the campaign
